description: This file defines the WidgetFactory class in the org.apache.ofbiz.widget package, responsible for creating instances of ModelScreenWidget based on XML elements and managing widget class registrations. It includes methods for loading standard widgets, registering custom widgets, and instantiating widget objects dynamically using reflection.

classes.name: WidgetFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to load, register, and instantiate widget models based on XML elements, supporting extension through custom widget loaders and reflection.

methods.name: getModelScreenWidget
methods.description: Creates a ModelScreenWidget instance based on the provided XML element and associated screen.

methods.name: loadStandardWidgets
methods.description: Loads predefined standard widgets into the factory by scanning ModelScreenWidget's nested classes and registering specific widget classes.

methods.name: registerScreenWidget
methods.description: Registers a widget class associated with a specific XML tag name, requiring the class to have a constructor accepting ModelScreen and Element.
